### PostgreSQL 16 Release Date
14 September 2023. Confirmed by the official PostgreSQL press release [1], the official release notes [2], and Phoronix's independent coverage [3].

### Principal Performance Improvement
PostgreSQL 16's headline performance improvement is the parallelization of `FULL` and right `OUTER` hash joins, which were previously the only major join types that could not run across multiple CPU cores. This expansion of the parallel query engine allows more complex analytical queries to benefit from multi-core execution, distributing hash join work across parallel workers for faster completion on large datasets. The official release notes list this as the #1 highlight [2], and it is corroborated by the press release's emphasis on query parallelism [1] and Phoronix's coverage [3]. Notably, this was paired with SIMD vectorized instruction support (SSE2 on x86-64, NEON on ARM) for accelerating ASCII, JSON, and array operations [1][3], and COPY bulk loading improvements reaching up to 300% speed gains in some cases [1][3].

- https://www.postgresql.org/docs/16/release-16.html
- https://www.phoronix.com/news/PostgreSQL-16-Released
</task_result>
